outcome: Mother transferred to inpatient psychiatry unit for higher-level care
Mother discharged home with close outpatient follow-up
cohort: A 36-year-old Gravida 6 Para 3113, non-English-speaking patient who presented for a scheduled repeat cesarean delivery and was diagnosed with new-onset peripartum psychosis.
finding: This case highlights the importance of addressing mental health concerns in pregnant patients and the vital role of interdisciplinary team management to ensure the safety of patients and their families, especially given the scarcity of data on new-onset psychosis in pregnancy.
